name: Weak Free Blade Safety Blitz
formation: 46 Free Blade vs Gun 21 Personnel 2x1 Right

summary.motive: Trade the free safety for a free weak-side runner while the boundary corner replaces him deep, keeping single-high shell integrity behind a five-man pressure.
summary.keyDefender: FS on the blade — unblocked by design because MIKE’s strong-side walk-up steals the running back’s scan
summary.whyItWorks: Protection rules send the back toward the walked-up linebacker, the hinge helps strong, and the blade hits the QB’s blind side before the third step.
summary.failureMode: A back who scans weak first, or a max-protect six-man slide, leaves the FB waiting on the blade and turns pressure into a coverage deficit outside.

beats.title: 1. The Blade Alignment
beats.text: The free safety stands alone at 8 yards over the weak B-gap with MIKE walking up strong as a decoy. The offense keys MIKE and slides protection away from the real threat.

beats.title: 2. Corner Rolls, Safety Fires
beats.text: At the snap the boundary corner bails over his receiver to take the deep middle while the free safety shoots downhill through the weak B-gap off the guard’s outside hip.

beats.title: 3. Hot Answer Walled Off
beats.text: The QB’s hot slant to X dies instantly because the rolled-down strong safety carries it man-to-man, and the running back has already committed to the walked-up MIKE on the wrong side.

beats.title: 4. Blind-Side Takedown
beats.text: The hinge blocker spins around one full second too late; the blade arrives untouched and the rolled corner owns everything behind him. Zero risk, five-man pressure.

relations.tell: One safety at 8 yards directly over the weak guard with a corner pressed opposite — the base 46 keeps both safeties in the box and no corner ever bails from the middle of the field.
